## L1 review (L1-d) · 2026-11-18T01:31Z

L1: ACCEPT
Head-sha: `695d9213ec9457bae88de2b8b59d971ee1d1840f`

Read against claim 6964921196 and card #35017. The change is 5 files, +275/-34, all inside the surface: `ConnectAssistantCard.tsx`, its host `HomePage.tsx`, the existing harness (`ConnectAssistantCard-30895`, which gains a new §8 and only a header line beyond it), the HomePage order pin beside it (`…homePlacement-35017`), and a changeset. It is not governed.

### Must-fix
None.

### Should-fix
None.

### Notes
- **Order.** On the apps branch the card moves out of the pre-column stack and into the content column, after the My work section (`HomeWork…`) and before the continue/activity row. When My work draws nothing, it follows the apps, as the card's "after My work (or My apps)" allows. The card drops its own padding and width wrapper, and the column supplies both.
- **Deviation 1 (no-apps branch) is accepted.** That branch has no greeting, apps or work, so following the role-aware welcome is the only reading of "never above the page's own content". The `empty:hidden` frame leaves no gap when the card draws nothing.
- **Deviation 2 (`sm` at 640, not 768) is accepted. I do not ask for 768.**
  - The card's acceptance is the 375 width, and from 640 to 767 the two-line card has the room it was designed for.
  - `usePhoneViewport` drives layout choices elsewhere, but nothing here needs to agree with it.
  - Switching would trade Tailwind's own breakpoint for a JS hook on a pure CSS change.
- **Mobile row.** The four children are the icon, the title box, Connect and close. The title is `truncate`, with `sm:whitespace-normal` above that width. The sentence is `sr-only sm:not-sr-only`, so it is still read out and never removed. §8 pins the structure and the classes, since jsdom applies no CSS.
- **The show condition and the checklist row are untouched**, and §1 to §7 stay green.
- **Live reading** (showcase, zh-CN). At 375 the card goes from 164px to 54px, under the card's ~64px. At 1280 the order goes from card, greeting, apps, work to greeting, apps, work, card. I looked at `after-375x812.png` in the seat's `35017-live/` folder: greeting, 我的应用, 我的工作, then a one-row 「在 AI 助手里使用本系统 · 连接 AI 助手 · ×」.
- **Ablation:** restoring the old position turns both with-apps order pins red, and the restore was proven, per report 6966215433.

Landing: not governed. CI on this exact head was still running when I read it (11 success, 13 skipped, 25 in progress). Area o3-H lands it once it is fully green. A later push owes a delta read.
